'''Bai Yilong''' ({{zh|s=白以龙}}; 22 December 1940 – 9 May 2024) was a Chinese mechanist and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was a member of the 10th and 11th National Committee of the [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.cas.cn/ys/gzdt/200303/t20030304_1676371.shtml |script-title=zh:力学所白以龙、胡文瑞当选第十届全国政协委员 |work=cas.cn |date=4 March 2003 |access-date=11 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="rg">{{cite news |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_27332807 |script-title=zh:沉痛悼念中国力学学会第六任理事长白以龙先生！ |work=thepaper |date=10 May 2024 |access-date=11 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Bai was born in [[Xiangyun County]], [[Yunnan]], on 22 December 1940, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Zhenhai District|Zhenhai County]], [[Zhejiang]].<ref name="ra">{{cite news |url=http://aga.ustc.edu.cn/info/1197/28791.htm |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士中的校友 |work=ustc.edu.cn |date=2021 |access-date=11 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> His father Bai Rubi ({{zh|s=白汝壁|labels=no}}) was a graduate of the Department of Civil Engineering, [[Beiyang University]] and once worked on the construction of the [[Yunnan–Burma railway]] in [[Yunnan]].<ref name="ra"/> His mother Cang Chuanxian ({{zh|s=仓传宪|labels=no}}) graduated from Zhili Women's First Normal School.<ref name="ra"/> He had three older sisters.<ref name="ra"/> In 1958, he enrolled at the [[University of Science and Technology of China]], where he majored in the Department of Modern Mechanics.<ref name="ra"/> He went to receive his master's degree from the Institute of Mechanics, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1966.<ref name="rb"/>

After graduation in 1966, Bai stayed at the Institute of Mechanics as an intern researcher.<ref name="rb"/> He moved up the ranks to become assistant researcher in 1979, associate researcher in 1982, and researcher in 1986.<ref name="rb"/> He was a visiting scholar at the [[Oxford University]] and [[Cambridge University]] from 1979 to 1981.<ref name="rb"/> In 1987, he was appointed deputy director of the Institute of Mechanics, and held that office until 1994.<ref name="rb"/> In 1998, he was proposed as president of the {{ill|Chinese Society of Theoretical Applied Mechanics|zh|中国力学学会}}, a position he held until 2002.<ref name="rg"/>

On 9 May 2024, Bai died in [[Beijing]], at the age of 83.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Wu Zhichao ({{lang|zh|伍智超}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_27312048 |script-title=zh:我国著名力学家、中科院院士白以龙逝世，享年83岁 |work=thepaper |date=9 May 2024 |access-date=11 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="rg"/>
* 1992 State Natural Science Award (First Class)<ref name="rb"/>
* 1993 State Natural Science Award (Second Class)<ref name="rb"/>
* 1999 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="rb">{{cite web |script-title=zh:白以龙|url=http://www.hlhl.org.cn/news/findnews/showsub.asp?id=4|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190611090241/http://www.hlhl.org.cn/news/findnews/showsub.asp?id=4|archive-date=11 June 2019|access-date=11 May 2024 |work=hlhl.org.cn |language=zh}}</ref>
* 1999 {{ill|Zhou Peiyuan Mechanics Award|zh|周培源力学奖}}<ref>{{cite news |author1=Shuai Junquan ({{lang|zh|帅俊全}})|author2=Chu Erjia ({{lang|zh|褚尔嘉}}) |url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20240510A04QNM00 |script-title=zh:中国著名力学家白以龙院士逝世 |work=qq.com |date=10 May 2024 |access-date=11 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 2002 Member of [[Academia Europaea]]<ref name="rb"/>
* 2007 John Rinehart Award<ref>{{cite news |url=https://imech.cas.cn/picnews/202302/t20230227_6683904.html |script-title=zh:力学所白以龙院士荣获John Rinehart奖 |work=cas.cn |date=26 April 2007 |access-date=11 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 2010 Mathematical Science Award of the {{ill|Chen Jiageng Science Award|zh|陈嘉庚科学奖}}<ref>{{cite web |script-title=zh:2010年度陈嘉庚数理科学奖获得者：白以龙|url=http://scitech.people.com.cn/GB/11831124.html|date=9 June 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304111600/http://scitech.people.com.cn/GB/11831124.html|archive-date=4 March 2016|access-date=11 May 2024|work=people.com.cn |language=zh}}</ref>
